_rules: Change only the 'passes' flags. Never delete an entry; add new ones at the end. Draft from Phase 0, 2026-10-01.

features.description: App boots on web; type-check and lint exit 0
Sign up / sign in with a 6-digit email code plus bot check; open sign-up
Row-level security: user A cannot read or write user B's rows; anon reads nothing
steps: run RLS test as A and B

features.description: QR storage is private: per-user paths, signed short-lived links, B cannot fetch A's file
People: add, edit, list; a person can be an organisation
Debts: add/edit/delete in either direction (I owe / Owed to me)
Fixed plan generates installments (amount x count from a start date)
Uneven plan: type or paste due dates and amounts
Open balance with optional pay-by date
Payments: real amount, oldest-first allocation, partly paid / paid late states, paid-in-full shortcut, overpay
Charges (late fee / penalty / interest) added by hand raise the remaining amount
Settle with write-off; settled debts move to Settled and can be reopened
Tab: running + added / - paid lines, two-tap entry, direction flips when crossing zero
Home: due next (overdue first), total I owe, due this month (with paid), owed to me; never netted
steps: all four above the fold at 360x640

features.description: Remaining and status are always calculated, never stored as typed numbers
steps: schema has no editable remaining column

features.description: Pay vault: add QR by photo/upload, label, wallet type, account name with copy, link to person/debt
Show QR full-screen and bright; works offline after first view; cache cleared on sign-out
QR swap warning: 'QR changed on <date>' after a replacement (final design from Phase 3)
Push reminders: day before and day of, 08:00 local; owed-to-me collect reminders; per-debt off switch
Backup file and restore (add missing / replace everything); QR excluded unless chosen
CSV export of debts and payments/lines
Share one debt as a summary image/text
Settings: appearance System/Light/Dark, currency (display only), reminder time, privacy note
Optional app MPIN, off by default; fresh open + 30 min away; server-verified with attempt limit
steps: 5 wrong tries falls back to email code

features.description: Delete my account removes all rows and QR files
Offline-first: saves land on the phone and sync when online
Importer dry run reproduces every reference figure and lists unmapped items (runs locally, read-only)
Real import reconciles with zero unexplained differences; re-run creates no duplicates
Phone's Back button, small screens, long names and offline cold start all behave
Fresh clone builds from the README; secret and personal-data scan clean
End-to-end check in SPEC.md section 14 passes all ten steps
